I don't think it affected the ssz serialization though, as it would still serialize properly to an empty list when nil. https://github.com/mdehoog/go-ethereum/pull/99 https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3244 - decoupled spec draft <@131476523050860545> hello! The blobs bundle will contain multiple blobs as before. The CL will then have to break up the bundle for gossip. sorry wrong link 😆 edited to fix I've just updated all lighthouse nodes. Will update geth once the PR gets merged Just merged this PR. Nice I was able to get a sync from genesis with that branch along with this one: https://github.com/realbigsean/lighthouse/tree/devnet-4-compat We did a rebase of our `eip4844` branch onto `capella` , and now require the `engine_exchangeCapabilities` endpoint there. excerpts.author: realbigsean
excerpts.content:
Nice I was able to get a sync from genesis with that branch along with this one:

https://github.com/realbigsean/lighthouse/tree/devnet-4-compat

We did a rebase of our `eip4844` branch onto `capella` , and now require the `engine_exchangeCapabilities` endpoint there. So that `devnet-4-compat` branch is the one to use with the EL versions present on devnet 4

I don't think we'll end up merging it to `eip4844` because it's a bit hacky but we can if anyone's interested
